Overview of the Entrance Examination System
This graduate school offers entrance examinations, as listed below.
Master’s program:
･Regular Admission (Summer Entrance Examination and Winter Entrance Examination)
Doctoral program:
･Regular Admission (Summer Entrance Examination and Winter Entrance Examination)
･Special Selection for Professionals (Summer Entrance Examination and Winter Entrance Examination)
Please select an appropriate entrance examination period by referring to the flowchart in Figure 1 below.
Note that the flowchart provides only a typical choice; as other examination periods may also be applicable,
please refer to the Admission Guides to check the details of eligibility requirements. Please also refer to
Figures 2 for the timeline of each entrance examination. For more detailed schedules, please consult the
